rows.grounds: optative of root cint; action directed by practitioner
feminine plural nominative agreeing with prior fierce forms
locative plural neuter; site of meditation

items.question: What should the practitioner meditate upon in all petty actions?
premises: all refers to prior fierce forms
items.inference: The practitioner should contemplate all fierce forms during every petty action.
uncertainties: exact referent of sakalāḥ depends on preceding verse
sarvvakṣudrakarmmasu may be locative of scope or instrument
items.plain_english: The practitioner should meditate on all of them in all petty actions.
